name: GPT-6 Astra
description: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's next major frontier model and is expected to become the largest and most capable model in the GPT series. It represents a substantial step forward from GPT-5.6 Sol in agentic work, computer use, token efficiency, alignment, and cybersecurity, with stronger ability to complete complex tasks with less human guidance. A broader release is expected imminently, potentially as early as September 3, 2026, although OpenAI has not confirmed a launch date.

page_notice.markdown: OpenAI says Astra will be available soon, but has not confirmed a launch date. Access is currently limited to approved projects, and public pricing and token limits have not been announced.

sources.notes: OpenAI describes Astra as a significant capability increase over GPT-5.6 Sol, its most aligned model to date, and its first model to reach the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold.
Conventional OpenAI model documentation URL reserved for the upcoming API reference page.

verification.notes: Exact ID and restricted project access are verified from OpenAI's repository. Live API access, pricing, limits, and full capabilities remain unverified.
